name: @theorionic/mcp-acp-bridge

tools.name: initialize_client
tools.description: Initialize a new ACP agent connection. Supported agents: gemini, opencode. You can pass custom arguments like --model.

agent.description: The preconfigured agent to connect to.

connectionId.description: A unique identifier for this connection (e.g., 'task-1').

cwd.description: Working directory for the agent. Overrides the default agent directory.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments to pass to the agent command (e.g., ['--model', 'gemini-2.0-flash']).

env.description: Environment variables for the agent process.

tools.name: send_prompt
tools.description: Send a prompt to a specific connected agent. Generation starts in the background unless 'wait' is true.

connectionId.description: The ID of the connection to send the prompt to.

wait.description: If true, blocks until the agent finishes generating the full response.

tools.name: read_response
tools.description: Read the current buffered response from a specific agent. This returns instantly even if the agent is still working.

connectionId.description: The ID of the connection to read from.

wait.description: If true, waits until any active generation completes before returning.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List all active ACP agent connections and their current status.

tools.name: close_connection
tools.description: Close an active ACP connection and terminate the underlying process.

connectionId.description: The ID of the connection to terminate.

stderr: ACP MCP Server running on stdio
